summary: This project provides the solution for people who are willing to build a spacecraft completely from scratch to any of the target destinations in our solar system by making decisions and allocating resources.
details: This project offers a hands-on solution for anyone who wants to build a spacecraft completely from scratch, stepping into the role of a mission architect by making critical design decisions and allocating resources. Rather than following a fixed path, users can select any celestial body across the solar system as their target destination and engineer a vessel capable of reaching and surviving it. Designed for curious minds, the experience reveals how spacecraft are constructed and how every single choice—from budget management to structural trade-offs—ultimately shapes whether a mission succeeds or fails. By opening up the entire solar system, the application encourages users to explore and understand the vastly different climatic and environmental realities of each world, leaving them with both genuine curiosity and practical knowledge. While building this platform, our team carefully balanced visual appeal, scientific accuracy, solar system accessibility, and realistic funding constraints. The application is built using HTML and deployed via Netlify, bringing together a collaborative AI workflow that utilized Gemini for research, Claude and Codex for coding.
